article.title: Congenital birth defects are on the rise in Gaza. Doctors say Israel’s genocide is to blame.
article.author: Tareq S. Hajjaj
article.content: Doctors in Gaza warn that exposure to bombs and toxic substances dropped by Israel on the strip is putting pregnant mothers and newborn infants at risk.
